summary: AABB collision body initializer. Zeroes the 24-byte header of the this object, then sets four trailing fields to defaults: the next/link pointer at +0x1C to 0, the body type byte at +0x19 to 0, the word handle at +0x1A to -1 (INVALID sentinel) and the active flag byte at +0x18 to 1. Returns the this pointer.

operations.description: memset(this, 0, 0x18) zeroes the 24-byte header region of the object.
Write 0 into the dword at this + 28 (+0x1C): next/free-list pointer set to null.
Write 0 into the byte at this + 25 (+0x19): body type set to default 0.
Write -1 (INVALID sentinel) into the word at this + 26 (+0x1A): handle/index set to invalid.
Write 1 into the byte at this + 24 (+0x18): active/in-use flag enabled.
